verdict.rationale: Trilegal is a full-service Indian law firm, a professional-services business rather than a software product or platform, so offering official SDKs to build against is a category error for this kind of product. The llms.txt file and the 404 OpenAPI probe are site-discovery artifacts, not evidence that the firm ships any developer SDK.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
